devices.scope: Savannah S100: locked documentary model and distinct signed synthetic archive. Exact −0.072 µm compatible exported profile accepted by unchanged Dektak simulator in actual browser; preserves sample ID, revision and axes. No layer creation/process operation.

Labcoter 2: fixed model and separate inert edge-coverage comparison. Reflection preserves edge classifications. Handles known zero, exposed and unknown separately; rejects incompatible height and impedance outputs. No coating simulation.

Ney Vulcan 3-1750: passive vertical-lift and inert gauge clearance, with sourced open/closed dimensions and clearly inferred connecting path. Blocks while moving or closed and refuses oversized items. No heating or process behavior.
Nanoquest I: dry carrier registration and synthetic heightfield replay. The unchanged 05-01 stylus simulator imported the exported sample and read the expected −68 nm step. No milling.
DISCO DAD321: sealed model, detached CAD-outline selection frame. Tested known ID-set changes, prohibited boundary crossings and wrong-axis import. This is not a cutting simulation.

DISCO DAG810: fixed bare case at specified nominal envelope, separate fictional virtual box to compare positive/negative signed spacing. Original room asset includes separate furniture and is not replaced. No grinding, service clearances or operation.

POLI-500 AC: sealed equipment and paired flatness-map review. A known radial comparison gives 2 µm peak-to-valley (0 for flat); typed profile imports into unchanged stylus viewer, preserving exact signed heights. Not a polishing simulation.

Minitech GX, ECL-FS3 enclosure fixed and opaque. Authored orientation/visibility geometry checks a virtual marker path; path can cross a reference even when both endpoints are clear. Supports no machine motion, machining or setup claims.

EVG 501: sealed enclosure and detached paired-outline registration. Alignment uses left and right fiducials, then checks an independent third mark. A large mismatch and wrong coordinate frame refuse export. No bonding workflow.

Nanoscribe GT2: sealed shell with explicitly proxy dimensions; detached CAD slice comparison reports a known +3 µm width difference, and distinguishes equal widths with displaced centers. Stable under viewport zoom. No writing or fabrication process.

Formlabs Form 4: virtual mechanical clearance with a moving hood and vertical gauge. Example part clears the edge by 17.5 mm when centered and crosses it by 3 mm when offset. Guarded motion and typed output. Does not simulate printing.

Classic Fluigent MFCS-EZ: inactive exterior and exact timing comparison on authored traces. Verified real 06-08 export ingests only for compatible timestamp and ID, with original electrical data attributed, not converted to flow or pressure. Wrong clocks or failed replacement clear previous export.

Fluigent Flow EZ: static LU-FEZ-1000 exterior with dimensionally sourced envelope but sibling photos. Virtual display reads an immutable synthetic signal; exact authored ramp and preserved missingness. No actual flow, controls or calibration.

New Era NE-1000 Rev A: visible dry schematic carriage uses documented motion direction and a separately authored span, with a signed dimensionless ruler result. Rejects missing ruler and invalid travel. No pump operation or physical travel claim.

Jeio Tech OF-12G solid left-door cabinet photos verified; cold authored geometry/symbolic outside gauge catches mid-arc collision on invented pose. No actual oven interior, heating, installation or use claims.
MicroTester G2: moving virtual dry fixture and elastic contact. Default model gives 2.560 mN at 16 µm; rejects invalid edges. Not calibrated real equipment.

Thermo 1305: sealed unchanged case; authored virtual glass overlay moves through nominal documented elevation range and compares abstract exterior heights. No chamber opening, airflow, operating settings, bio or safety behavior.

Thermo 160i: published external form with authored showroom door arc, original opaque interior stays sealed. Compares full virtual sweep against visual endpoint for abstract posts. No measured real door travel or conditioning.

Nikon Ts2-FL: virtual mechanical stage, focus and nosepiece linked to a synthetic reticle. Both 10× and 20× recover the known 10 µm pitch; failure cases refuse results. JSON and raster export. No biological imaging or physical calibration.
Eppendorf 5810 R: closed exact-model shell and a separate dimensionless diagram for fourfold mass moments. Correct vector balance and offset, no real rotor geometry or centrifuge operation.

Countess 3 FL: sealed verified model and external non-fitting ink-dot reference card. Threshold changes known counts 8→5→2; missing region never yields a false full count. Does not model the real optical path, cell counting or device insertion.

SpectraMax i3x: fixed exact-model exterior with separate addressed dry optical witness. Example checks finite absorbance, ideal opaque vs missing, and blank correction. Moves only the conceptual ROI; not an operating plate-reader simulation.

Thermo TSX60086A Gen 2 virtual dry pocket custody. One test box moves with exact identity; guarded occupied, out-of-fit and refused states. No cooling, preservation, physical fit or headset qualification.
EVG 810LT: a guided inert two-face fit with rejection for overlap and a reproducible clearance receipt. No surface treatment.
Ultimus V: corrected inert console plus separate interactive dry height fixture, 460→920 nL geometry result. The dispenser itself is not simulated.

JBC DDSE: the station exterior is inactive. A detached dry fixture moves to test a synthetic continuity graph and distinguishes intact, open, and unintended connection. Incorrect orientation refuses. No soldering or hardware operation.

Sutter BV-10-D and BV-10S 40×: inferred geometric joint and virtual registration only. Moving an abstract three-mark gauge changes its projected position while preserving its 2 mm baseline and 0.8 mm² area. No disk operation or beveling.

Doric NC500 + iLFMC4-G3: sealed original models and synthetic multistream trace viewer. Tagged alignment changes a known 0.25→0.50 ratio; invalid clocks and missing values refuse rather than silently substituting zero. No instrument acquisition.

Thorlabs PM100D/S150C: a virtual connector seats before synthetic optical-power readings. Matching the example data and calibration label gives 100 µW; changing that label gives 54.545 µW. Blocks partial seating and out-of-range data. No real power source or meter calibration.

ORCA-Flash4.0 V3: sealed camera and archived raster review. Distinguishes display clipping, recorded maximum code, and missing data. Browser-tested Nikon 07-03 PNG+JSON handoff keeps original pixels and scale; altered pixels are refused. No camera acquisition.

ZEISS GeminiSEM 560: sealed illustrative-scale cabinet and detached planar image ruler. Known 2.000 and 1.000 µm observations, anisotropic axes, and absolute-scale refusal on identical uncalibrated raster. Not an SEM simulation.

JEOL JEM-1400 Plus locked exterior and separate signed grid analysis. Verified exact Nikon dry-grid receipt and authored synthetic shear/residual checks, raw axes/provenance retained. Not microscope operation or real calibration.

Leica UC7i / M80: documented carrier angles drive virtual optical inspection. A 100 µm target distance stays fixed while its projection changes. Pivot and optics are inferred; specimen bay stays sealed and sectioning is not simulated.

Bruker SKYSCAN 1272 CMOS: sealed cabinet and offline synthetic voxel viewer. Known 10.44031 mm center separation and 112 mm³ labeled volume across two pitches. Distinguishes unknown from empty and validates exported volume on reimport. No scanner operation or reconstruction.
TA Q50: cold virtual balance observation with paired baseline, 80.0% versus 80.4% unpaired. Readings are synthetic; no thermal program.

TA Q20: sealed model with signed thermal trace replay. Independent synthetic comparison recovers 450 mJ with drift correction, vs 495/675 mJ simplified baselines, and zero for matched blank. No heating or handling simulation.

FLIR E95: corrected inert body size and detached synthetic radiance ratio analysis. Known ratios 2, 0.5, and 0.75; incomplete coverage and uncalibrated absolute temperature are refused. Not a sensing simulation. The room clearance must be rechecked before replacement.

Custom 14-11 R3 dry witness: move A or B software tokens into one dock and replay a signed synthetic impedance record. Known changed bin is +10%; archive missingness remains distinct from a measured zero. This is not soaking or an acquisition workflow.

ESPEC SH-262: modeled left-hinged door and passive virtual rack/footprint clearance. Observed valid +20 mm, tangent and blocked jamb; authored hinge stop and rack position. No conditioning or physical fit qualification.

Nikon SMZ25 R2: modeled zoom, focus and stage change one idealized dry reticle readout. Known 1 mm spacing at multiple zooms; clipped/defocused reads refuse. Cannot read while geometry is moving, and drafts are not successful exports. Native geometry unchanged from R1, independently verified room fit. No hardware calibration or physical headset test.

Noldus CatWalk XT 10.7: built-in moving geometric marker shares a virtual pad, capture cursor and footprint record. Default two 100 ms contacts and 30 mm repeat displacement; changed 140/90 ms and 41 mm. Refuses clipped/missing coverage. No animal or camera workflow.

Noldus EthoVision XT register candidate has no exact release number. Separate genuine threshold/connected-components analysis of a synthetic raster stack accurately tracks inert markers, calibrated distance and gaps. Neither emulates EthoVision nor operates hardware.

Bruker BioSpec 70/30 nominal bare axis: sealed model and a virtual gauge aligned to the authored signed frame and nominal 300 mm ring. Tests centered and offset clearance; not usable configured bore, scanning or calibration.

Bruker SkyScan 1276 sealed model and offline comparison of two synthetic volumes. Accepted exact 13-15 browser-produced original file; signed axes, pitches and unknown masks are kept, 0.75 synthetic overlap. Not scanner acquisition, reconstruction or physical calibration.

Vevo 3100 legacy cart and fixed representative accessory, separate inert time-of-flight lesson. Moving the abstract 3D slide changes two apparent depths from 8/20 to 12/24 mm while spacing stays fixed. No ultrasound acquisition or working Vevo simulation.

Bioptigen Envisu C2300: a modeled portable head moves to an author-defined holder and reveals known sections of an idealized layered phantom. Reads 20 and 28 µm at selected rows and refuses partial coverage. No OCT acquisition or calibration.

TDT RZ6-A-P1 / legacy RA4PA: inactive units and separate cassette archive for four lanes of synthetic pulses; preserves recorded zeros, missing route, timing and revision. No hardware signal acquisition.

Legacy Tuttnauer 3870EA closed exterior and authored virtual placement footprint. Verified mobile/body transform and margins; alternate same-name variants separate. No door travel, pressure or real function.
Fisher Isotemp GPD 05: documented 90° cover with inferred pivot datum and dry envelope check; centered +10 mm, turn −3 mm, and tangency refusal. No real-bath operation or liquid/thermal behavior.
Branson CPX1800H: exact represented cold case, cover lift reveals a geometric envelope diagram of the nominal rim. Synthetic comparison only, not actual usable tray clearance or ultrasonic cleaning.
